base_sha_note: dispatch packet BASE; the gate's base_sha item measured HEAD == BASE at write time
phase_law: I implements runner machinery ONLY: NO scored execution on real data, NO outcome numbers on real data anywhere; real-substrate access limited to structural plumbing (digests, series lengths, config assembly)

measured.note: the gate is written pre-commit on the verified BASE; the I substance commit sha is published in the committed structured handoff

measured.digest_law: sha256(canonical JSON of the arm's config object only; sort_keys, tight separators, ensure_ascii)

measured.consumption_law: ETP legs consumed ONLY through corp_actions.event_adjusted_closes (never raw, never vendor-adjusted)

measured.cost_once_per_fill: kernel law, unit-tested; per-fill cost = notional x measured half-spread x tier

measured.anchor_builders: D2 committed builders re-used unchanged (equality unit-tested on synthetic contexts)

rule_order: R1 EXPECTANCY: after-cost expectancy > 0 on the PRIMARY NET book at cost tier 2.0 (Q-16 path component included; cost charged once per fill)

R2 CONTROL_KILL: the arm's index-only re-clock control out-earns the arm same-sign at >= 0.5x per round trip (falsification-by-control law), OR the calendar-clock shadow placement is not distinct from the arm placement, OR the seeded placebo produces a significant differential placement -- each is a VETO. This is the binding site of the VOLNG1-A5-P2 D1 falsification rule (non-distinctness kill).
R3 FOLDS: >= 2/3 frozen temporal folds with positive after-cost expectancy (folds frozen below; no fold boundary moves after any scored number)
R4 PROFIT_FACTOR: profit factor >= 1.10 on the PRIMARY NET book with margin recorded (P-2)

R5 STRESS: after-cost expectancy still > 0 under the stress convention -- the FULL measured path-cost ladder at tier 2.0 PRIMARY including every leg's Q-16 roll/decay path component, the A4-P2 forced-rebalance multiplier and the A5-P2 both-bucket rotation costs. This is the binding site of the VOLNG1-A4-P2 D1 falsification rule (cost-ceiling family kill).
R6 NON_CONCENTRATION: drop-one-fold survival AND no single round trip > 50% of the cell's gross
measured.survivor_law: survivor := an arm passes ALL of R1..R6 -> PROVISIONAL_STAGE_A_SURVIVOR (S1 stays SEALED; no rescue after scored numbers are visible)
measured.fail_closed_law: a rule whose metric is missing or uncomputable evaluates NOT_RUN (never an inferred PASS); any NOT_RUN rule blocks the survivor verdict (Q-11; PLAN_crypto_ng1.md section 7 law as realized in the FOREX I evaluator)
measured.unit_tested: per-rule PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN on hand-built synthetic metric fixtures
